all.text: Mairsil usurps his teacher Ith's position and steals the Wand of Ith, which he uses to drain Primata Delphine's defenses before stabbing her to death during her assault on the Conclave.
In Lim-Dûl's Battle, Jaya defeats Chaeska and claims Lim-Dûl's severed hand, unaware that it bears Mairsil's ring.
Wearing the ruby ring, Jaya is possessed by Mairsil and cuts Jodah's throat, but Jodah survives and smashes his mirror in her face, burning away Mairsil and Lim-Dûl.
Jaya's planeswalker spark flares and she erases Mairsil's presence and destroys the war beasts.

mbc.text: On the set's cards Mairsil is a figure who asks what anyone has that he cannot obtain.
